speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Eggs, and ling, and the settle by the fire. Sit down before you read him anything. A man who reads standing spills.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Buttered eggs and ling. Sixpence, when you come for it. Dick has not heard this act. I am going to read it as far as it goes, and it does not go to the end.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then read. Thou hast promised it since Thursday by the way thou wouldst not show it. I am here. Begin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Worthies come in brave, and each of them loses the name before the show is done. The yard laughs because the name fails.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A pageant that cannot remember itself. Go on. I can see the mess, and the mess is playable.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It could have ended on the laugh. It does not. A man comes in, in black, among all their colours. He says half a line. She ends it. The half he says is The king your father, and the rest of the line is empty. I have not filled it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Empty is a strange gift to an actor. Leave it empty if that is the truth of it. What does she do with the year?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They do not marry. Not today. A twelvemonth and a day. Let them earn it where the play cannot see.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Say the last of that again, and then do not help me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not for a twelvemonth and a day.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And I get her not?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not for a twelvemonth and a day.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: That's too long for a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I hear you. I am writing it, and I am writing it as his, not as yours.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: As whose? If thou givest my objection to the lover, say so, and do not make me stand in the yard and beg a year I have already lost.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Berowne's. The objection is Berowne's now. Thou shalt have it back as a line, not as a complaint at supper.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Dinner's sixpence, wit's extra, and that's the first time I saw a player pay for a line.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sixpence for the eggs, then, and nothing for the year, since the year is not mine anymore. Thou art a thief with a very straight face, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am a thief of one sentence. The rest of the act is still mine, and the rest of his line is still empty, and thou hast not heard an ending because there is not one.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Empty or not, the plates are done. Sixpence from each of you, and the fire is not extra. I charge wit when I hear it. I heard it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Pay her. Then tell me whether I am to wait a year in the play or only at this table, because at this table I will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In the play. A twelvemonth and a day. At this table you may have your eggs in the ordinary time. I have the line down. I am not giving you a part tonight, and I am not writing the end of it here.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Parts I do not serve. Supper I do. You have had the ling. The sixpences, and then the lane, before the settle thinks you live here.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Too long for a play. Remember that I said it before it was clever. I said it because I do not get her.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will remember. It is already the lover's. Come. The walk is colder than this room, and I have what I came for.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Colder is not my business past the door. Sixpence, Master Shakespeare. Wit was included, and I shall not make a habit of it.
